definitions.p_answer: mean_i exp(-saved NLL[i,0]); gold final-answer token, full vocabulary
definitions.p_eos_given_gold: mean_i exp(-saved NLL[i,1]); teacher-forced gold answer
definitions.p_gold_sequence: mean_i exp(-NLL[i,0]-NLL[i,1]); gold answer then EOS
definitions.complete_accuracy: saved greedy answer equals target AND EOS after that generated answer
definitions.generated_eos_accuracy: saved stop equals EOS id 1; answer correctness is separate
definitions.answer_correct_eos_wrong_fraction: population fraction with correct answer but missing EOS
definitions.atomic_partition: complete-fact membership in saved ID/OOD edge partition; both trained
definitions.world_summary: average initializations within each world; then weight worlds equally
definitions.bands: range of world means; descriptive, not confidence intervals
definitions.decline_rebound: three consecutive saved nodes; decline then rebound, tolerance 1e-8
definitions.magnitude_counts: 1pp/5pp are descriptive bins; not significance or selection criteria
definitions.resolution: observed changes span saved update intervals; no between-node inference
definitions.missingness: null for absent or zero-denominator observations; never replaced by zero
definitions.scope: no predictor, checkpoint selection, forward pass, training or historical rewriting
definitions.id_full: test_full_composite measured at fixed endpoint only; never mixed with probe
definitions.autonomous: hard scores only; saved external-call arrays have no NLL
definitions.unavailable_margin: wrong-answer probabilities and logits not saved; P(correct)-P(incorrect) cannot be reconstructed
